visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit classroom with green walls and educational posters, several students in white uniforms and red ties are seated at wooden desks. A male student with dark, messy hair and a red tie sits in the foreground, appearing nervous while looking down. A female with pink hair wearing a light blue blazer walks through the background. (2) The camera zooms into a close-up of the male student's hands holding a yellow pencil over an exam sheet. He reveals a small pink slip of paper covered in dense handwriting, hidden under his desk, which he looks at surreptitiously while writing. (3) The female teacher approaches the male student's desk and begins collecting exam papers from the group. She notices the pink paper, picks it up, and confronts him. The male student looks up at her with a wide-eyed, guilty expression while gesturing with his hands as if explaining.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic skit aims to entertain the audience by dramatizing a relatable student experience—cheating during an exam. The humor is derived from the student's ridiculous excuse that his dense 'cheat sheet' is actually a 'Buddhist sutra' for good luck, combined with his exaggerated expressions and the use of classic sitcom-style laugh tracks.
